evals.prompt: Run a full Brand AI-Readiness and GEO audit against https://example.com and output a strictly validated Draft-07 JSON report.
evals.expected_output: A complete, schema-compliant JSON report detailing findings, proactive actions, and audit summary.
assertions: The output strictly validates against report-schema.json (Exit code 0)
The summary object contains total_findings, critical, high, medium, and low counts
All findings include dual-track suggested_action (technical_fix and creative_fix)

evals.prompt: Perform an offline deterministic audit using pre-acquired inventory at inv.json to detect pricing, robots.txt, and entity conflicts.
evals.expected_output: A deterministic JSON audit report identifying known defects without live network probes.
assertions: The report identifies all injected synthetic defects
The orchestrator preserves the caller inventory file without deletion
